Fixes dev-skill-up/pitboss#464

Head: bc81a08148eb05b2aac95ec859e557b0a718fdc8

Done-when digest: 3be37b228e6647e8

## Plan

Each Done-when item of #464 word for word, with its evidence; the command rows first, the CI pointers last.

1. The head: `git rev-parse HEAD`.
2. Done when 1, quoted below. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_the_offered_step_names_the_check_and_its_job` and `test_the_step_is_a_fix`; the run of the head is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43009810309, the job page https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43009810309/job/130486279303.
```
For a PR whose newest head has a completed failing check, the step `slots next` offers is a fix step, not a review step, and the step names the failing check and its job URL. Demonstrated by: a test with a world holding a PR with one failed check, asserting the offered step and its text.
```
3. Done when 2: The printed fix brief is a worker brief on the PR's branch with the failing check as its task. Demonstrated by: a test asserting the brief's `PITBOSS-SLOT` line ends in `fix` and holds the check's name. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_the_brief_is_a_fix_on_the_branch_with_the_check`; the run of the head is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43009810309, the job page https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43009810309/job/130486279303.
4. Done when 3: A PR whose checks are still running or green keeps its review step. Demonstrated by: two tests, one world with a running check and one with all checks green, asserting the review step. CI pointer: workflow `pr-main.yml`, job `tests`, step `Run Nox`, greppable `test_a_running_check_keeps_the_review` and `test_green_checks_keep_the_review`; the run of the head is https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43009810309, the job page https://github.com/dev-skill-up/pitboss/actions/runs/43009810309/job/130486279303.

## Execution

- The step of a draft (`flow.draft_gate`) ignored a failed check: a draft whose Plan was not approved went to the Plan review, so `slots next` offered "review it" for quire#1104 (a draft, `canonical-files` failed). Now a draft with a failed check, whose newest review is no rejection, takes `ci_gate`, which gives the fix of the CI (or the wait of a ruling), keyword: draft-red-ci.
- The check the Plan review itself waits for (`plan_review_check`) failing is not counted (`draftfacts.failed_besides`), since a red Plan check is the review's own case (`test_a_red_completed_run_is_completed`, quire#1058); tests for it and for a different failing name are in `test_draft_red_ci.py`.
- The fix brief is the existing one (`FIX_CI`, with `Failed check log: <name>: <job URL>`); no brief code changed.
- `draft_gate` is shortened (the two walrus ifs are one `or`) and `get_plan_rejections` is a `sum`, so `flow.py` stays under the line and complexity limits.
- Fix round of the review of 07f55c3 (Opus ruling: do these steps): the first docstring line of `draft_gate` now says a red check but the Plan's is fixed first (draft-red-ci).
- Local: the four sessions of `pitboss nox` on the head passed (skills, lint, mypy, tests-3.13); the rest is CI's.

Deviations: none

## Evidence

```pitboss-expand sha256=3b3695553820718a head=bc81a08148eb05b2aac95ec859e557b0a718fdc8
$ git rev-parse HEAD
bc81a08148eb05b2aac95ec859e557b0a718fdc8
```
